title: Wire results view together
story: As a user, I want to see my highlighted writing and score on a single results screen after the exercise so that I get a complete picture of my performance.
acceptance_criteria: A Results view composes HighlightedText and Score components
Shown automatically when analysis completes after the timer expires
A 'Start New Exercise' button is present and resets the app to the start screen
Unit tests cover rendering with analysis results and the reset action
